people.name: Asahel
people.line: Opposed Ezra's dissolution of mixed marriages

people.name: Jahzeiah
people.line: Opposed Ezra's command for Israelites to divorce foreign wives.

people.name: Jonathan
people.line: Opposed divorcing foreigners, with Jahzeiah and Meshullam

people.name: Levi
people.line: Son of Jacob; progenitor of the Levites

people.name: Meshullam
people.line: Opposed Ezra's plan to put away foreign wives.

people.name: Shabbethai
people.line: Levite who opposed Ezra's marriage reforms

people.name: Tikvah
people.line: Opposed Ezra's reforms regarding foreign wives

translations.web: Only Jonathan the son of Asahel and Jahzeiah the son of Tikvah stood up against this; and Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite helped them.
translations.bsb: (Only Jonathan son of Asahel and Jahzeiah son of Tikvah, supported by Meshullam and Shabbethai the Levite, opposed this plan.)
